Spacecraft name MAGNETO (Magento)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 1.5U
Status not launched, expected in 2026
Launcher not launched
Organisation University of Southern California
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Nation US
Oneliner

Educational mission to take magnetometer measurements with no uplink capability.
Description

Build, integration and launch a 1U satellite within a single semester. Take magnetometer measurements. UHF Beacon only to send information down, no active control and no uplink capability.

Payload objectives include creating a high fidelity map of magnetic field strength using Sponsor sensors, acquiring data in launch environment (to be transmitted once in orbit), and validating electronics on orbit.
Notes

FireFly has offered a free launch spot, and the 1U will enter LEO orbit.
